name: osmosis
description: Learn Mandarin by osmosis: a short vocab card under each Codex reply, with words from the reply checked against CC-CEDICT.

interface.shortDescription: A Mandarin vocab card under each reply
interface.longDescription: After each reply, Osmosis picks a few words from it at your HSK level and shows them under the reply with pinyin, meaning, HSK level and a character breakdown. The card is for you only; Codex does not see it. Type $osmosis to change the level, density or model.
